title: Amazon’s Streaming TV Pitch to Mid-Market Brands: What Actually Works

facts.fact: Amazon rebranded Sponsored TV to Streaming TV in 2025, and new campaigns are created under 'Streaming TV' in the Ads Console.
facts.quote: Amazon rebranded Sponsored TV to **Streaming TV** in 2025. Existing Sponsored TV campaigns continue to run uninterrupted

facts.fact: Self-service Streaming TV has no minimum spend, uses CPM billing, and requires Brand Registry eligibility.
facts.quote: yes, the self-service door has no minimum spend. CPM billing, daily budget you set, eligibility requires Brand Registry

facts.fact: Agencies typically recommend a starting budget of around $10,000 monthly for self-service DSP to generate enough impressions for meaningful optimization.
facts.quote: agencies typically recommend a starting budget of around $10,000 monthly to generate enough impressions for meaningful optimization

facts.fact: Managed-service DSP starts at $50K.
facts.quote: Managed-service DSP starts at $50K.

facts.fact: Amazon's ad spec calls for a 15 Mbps minimum bitrate to maximize supply coverage for Streaming TV video.
facts.quote: Amazon’s ad spec calls for a 15 Mbps minimum bitrate to maximize supply coverage, MP4 format, and durations between 6 and 45 seconds.

facts.fact: Streaming TV video durations must be between 6 and 45 seconds, in MP4 format.
facts.quote: MP4 format, and durations between 6 and 45 seconds.

facts.fact: A purpose-built 15 or 30 second Streaming TV spot, produced well, runs into five figures according to the author.
facts.quote: A purpose-built 15 or 30 second spot, produced well, runs into five figures.

facts.fact: Amazon reports that customer journeys exposed to Streaming TV alongside other sponsored ads drove 58% better New-to-Brand conversion rates compared to journeys without TV (Amazon's own internal data).
facts.quote: Amazon reports that customer journeys exposed to Streaming TV alongside other sponsored ads drove 58% better New-to-Brand conversion rates

facts.fact: The author's rule of thumb is that if Sponsored Display spend is under 10% of total Amazon ad budget, the retargeting layer should be fixed first.
facts.quote: If your SD spend is under 10% of your total Amazon ad budget, fix that first.

facts.fact: The article's target audience is brands doing $150K to $750K a month on Amazon.
facts.quote: If you run a brand doing $150K to $750K a month on Amazon

facts.fact: DVA+ combines Sponsored TV, Sponsored Display, and programmatic buying into one campaign covering streaming TV, online video, and display, with audio coming soon.
facts.quote: DVA+ combines what used to run through Sponsored TV, Sponsored Display, and programmatic buying into one campaign covering streaming TV, online video, and display, with audio coming soon.

facts.fact: Canopy's partners average an 84% year-over-year profit increase, according to Canopy's own claim on the page.
facts.quote: why Canopy’s partners average an 84% year-over-year profit increase with 99.1% retention.

facts.fact: Amazon Streaming TV was launched in October 2023 under the name Sponsored TV.
facts.quote: It launched in October 2023 as Sponsored TV and was rebranded to Streaming TV in 2025

facts.fact: Sponsored TV was rebranded to Streaming TV in 2025.
facts.quote: was rebranded to Streaming TV in 2025 when Amazon consolidated self-service and DSP-bought TV into a single platform.

facts.fact: Streaming TV places ads on Prime Video, Twitch, Fire TV Channels, and third-party streaming inventory through Amazon Publisher Direct.
facts.quote: placing ads on Prime Video, Twitch, Fire TV Channels, and third-party streaming inventory through Amazon Publisher Direct.

facts.fact: Self-service Streaming TV is accessed through the Ads Console, requires Brand Registry enrollment, and has no minimum spend.
facts.quote: Self-service Streaming TV is accessed through the Ads Console, requires Brand Registry enrollment, and has no minimum spend.

facts.fact: DSP Streaming TV has a $10K recommended self-service minimum.
facts.quote: DSP Streaming TV requires a $10K recommended self-service minimum or a $50K managed-service minimum

facts.fact: A Streaming TV test needs a media budget of at least a few thousand dollars monthly, according to the page's guidance.
facts.quote: a media budget large enough to generate enough impressions to evaluate (a few thousand dollars monthly at minimum)

facts.fact: The page advises budgeting five figures for production-quality creative if a brand lacks TV-grade video assets.
facts.quote: Plan on five figures for production-quality creative if you don’t already have TV-grade video assets

facts.fact: The page recommends at least 60 to 90 days of consistent spend before drawing conclusions from a Streaming TV campaign.
facts.quote: Plan on at least 60 to 90 days of consistent spend before drawing conclusions.

facts.fact: Brand Lift studies, where eligible, can deliver initial directional results in 7 to 14 days.
facts.quote: Brand Lift studies, where eligible, can deliver initial directional results in 7 to 14 days

facts.fact: Streaming TV requires a minimum 15 Mbps video bitrate to maximize supply coverage.
facts.quote: Streaming TV requires a minimum 15 Mbps video bitrate to maximize supply coverage, MP4 format

facts.fact: Streaming TV video durations must be between 6 and 45 seconds depending on placement.
facts.quote: durations between 6 and 45 seconds depending on placement.
